scope: Actual AppNavRail source and production stylesheet compiled with Vite production build; static fixture props and a disposable local component host. No backend routes are mocked or contacted.
limitations: This is component-level Chromium acceptance, not the authenticated full application.
Fixture host owns keyboard shortcut and mobile sheet mount/close state; production app integration is separately covered by local unit tests.
No deployed-site, Cloudflare, provider, Slack, email, account, container or remote-computer verification.
